special_notes: Researcher lane branches mostly share the old template SHA. Their names are placeholders for code workflow; no claim that source was migrated.
All historical ref names remain unchanged to preserve existing backlinks, Git SHAs, and rollback evidence.
Two legacy archive aliases are namespaced and versioned; original refs remain available.
14 resource branches have unique scoped manifest commits based on the new Dawn theme code and include the whole repository tree.
Git snapshots are immutable by policy; routine changes belong on feature/task branches then main, with dated release snapshots when needed.
Compiled PDFs/PPTX and scientific original files remain Google Drive authority.
main moves with commits; observed main SHA is the parent of the catalog-only update. Future live GitHub HEAD must be fetched before any write.
2026-10-09 v003 immutable PRE control bridge snapshot was provider-verified before the control change. A future release ref requires separate provider readback.
